slides.slide_title: Introduction to LLM: attention + linear layers
slides.slide_claim: An LLM is mainly composed of attention layers and linear (Liner) layers
slide_key_text: The LLM mainly consists of attention layers and linear layers

slides.slide_title: 大模型稀疏重训练成本远高于小模型
slides.slide_claim: 与 AI 1.0 小模型不同,大模型稀疏重训练极其昂贵,难以有效利用稀疏性
slide_key_text: Different from AI 1.0 models, sparse retraining of large models is expensive
The training cost of LLM is much higher than that of small models
slide_visual_skeleton: 红字高亮成本 + 下箭头

slides.slide_title: 基于统计注意力分布自动生成稀疏掩码
slides.slide_claim: 依据输入的统计注意力分布自动生成稀疏 mask,保信息同时降算力
slide_key_text: Based on the statistical attention distribution, a sparse attention mask is automatically generated to maintain the original information while reducing calculation
Attention matrix at different positions of a model
Artificial mask: affects data distribution and requires retraining
Statistically generated mask: reduced impact without retraining or simple fine-tuning
slide_visual_skeleton: 注意力矩阵转换箭头图

slides.slide_title: 微调替代重训练,密度更低
slides.slide_claim: 用微调代替重训练即可稀疏化,收敛快且密度降至 15.6%,优于同类
slide_key_text: Fine-tuning from pre-trained dense model to sparse model
slide_visual_skeleton: 右侧密度对比表(ours 红框)

slides.slide_title: 稀疏掩码近乎无损降算力(精度降<0.14%)
slides.slide_claim: 稀疏掩码在可接受精度内降算力:无重训练精度仅降0.14%,微调后反升0.37%
slide_key_text: The use of sparse masks reduces model calculations while keeping accuracy changes within an acceptable range
Pretrained model -> sparse attention: without retraining, accuracy drops within 0.14%
Pretrained model -> super sparse attention + fine-tuning on 1.5K sentences: accuracy increased by 0.37%
slide_visual_skeleton: 两栏精度对比 + chart 占位
下方长文本摘要示例框

slides.slide_title: 稀疏 LLM 访存受限,单一编译映射难达最优
slides.slide_claim: 稀疏 LLM 算子访存受限,单一编译映射得不到最优数据流,算力利用率低
slide_key_text: Operators in sparse LLM generally have limited memory access, and a single compilation mapping cannot obtain the optimal data flow, resulting in low utilization of computing units
The attention operator has the characteristic of limited memory access

slides.slide_title: 分块后访存量取决于块大小,算子融合非总有益
slides.slide_claim: 计算任务分块后访存量与块大小相关,块越小访存越大,算子融合并非总有益
slide_key_text: Operator fusion does not always bring benefits, depending on the relationship between the size of the computing task and hardware resources
Consider the amount of memory access after computing tasks are divided into blocks
The amount of memory access is related to the block size of the computing task
The smaller the block, the greater the amount of memory access

slides.slide_title: 片上存储受限使融合数据流访存反增(13x)
slides.slide_claim: 片上存储有限致其他维度数据复用变差,融合数据流反而放大总访存
slide_key_text: No operator fusion (10x memory access amount)
Due to limited on-chip storage, data reuse in other dimensions becomes worse and the total memory access becomes larger
slide_visual_skeleton: 矩阵乘法维度数字标注
融合/不融合访存量对比

slides.slide_title: 基于 M3 建模的自适应稀疏数据流
slides.slide_claim: 提出稀疏多矩阵乘(M3)模型,依任务与硬件自适应选择最优数据流
slide_key_text: A sparse multi-matrix multiplication (M3) model is proposed to adaptively select the best execution data flow based on the input of the task and hardware
Adaptive sparse data flow based on M3
Hardware constraints + Computing tasks -> Best data flow
Apply non-fused data flow / Apply fused data flow
slide_visual_skeleton: M3 模型输入→输出框图

slides.slide_title: M3 建模多算子组合的稀疏线性层示例
slides.slide_claim: 考虑稀疏后 M3 可建模多种算子组合,以稀疏线性层为例判定融合优劣
slide_key_text: After considering sparsity, the multi-matrix multiplication model can be used to model multiple operator combinations
Dense operator / Sparse attention / Sparse FFN
Better without fusion / Better with fusion

slides.slide_title: SpMM 与 SDDMM 主导,离散设计硬件昂贵
slides.slide_claim: 稀疏算子以 SpMM、SDDMM 为主,为各算子离散设计专用硬件开销高
slide_key_text: Large models have multiple sparse operators at the same time, and it is expensive to design the hardware architecture discretely
Sparse operators SpMM and SDDMM dominate
Designing dedicated hardware architectures for different sparsity operators is expensive
slide_visual_skeleton: 离散设计 vs 可配置硬件对比框

slides.slide_title: 可配置乘法器阵列与归约单元架构
slides.slide_claim: 结合稀疏方法复用算子间共性,设计可配置架构以最小化硬件开销
slide_key_text: Combined with the sparse method, maximize the reusable structure between different sparse operators, and design a configurable hardware architecture to minimize hardware overhead
Schematic diagram of data path on SpMM and SDDMM
slide_visual_skeleton: Tensor Core 输入/输出路径框图

slides.slide_title: 输入路径:按算子顺序复用的可配置数据通路
slides.slide_claim: 输入路径按不同稀疏算子运算顺序复用数据路径(select/transpose)
slide_key_text: Matrix input path: multiplex the input data path according to the order of different sparse operator operations

slides.slide_title: 输出路径:块重要度稀疏模式复用归约树
slides.slide_claim: 输出路径结合块重要度稀疏模式复用归约树,不扩位宽、不增连线
slide_key_text: Matrix output path: combined with block importance-based sparse mode to minimize additional hardware architecture overhead
Only expands the data bit width, no additional connection structure is required

slides.slide_title: 相比现有架构加速最高达 2 倍
slides.slide_claim: 在 BERT-6.7B、OPT-6.7B 上,相比现有硬件架构速度最高提升 2 倍
slide_key_text: Compared with the existing hardware architecture, the speed is increased by up to 2 times
Baseline: Tensor core, SpMM accelerator Sextans, LLM accelerator Sanger
slide_visual_skeleton: 右侧 BERT/OPT 评测图区

extraction_notes: 本 batch 仅 1 个 deck(ASP-DAC Tutorial 93 页 11 sections), 抽出 10 个 patterns(其中 opening_cover_plus_progress_highlighted_toc 复用 batch 0 已有 id, 其余 9 个为新 pattern)。每 pattern 仅 1 carrier(单 deck 限制), confidence 多为 low。跨 batch dedup: sec.01 复用 opening_cover_plus_progress_highlighted_toc(与 batch 0 定义 applicable_when + abstract_node_sequence 一致)。batch 内 dedup: case_study_challenge_solution_performance_closed_loop(sec.06) 与 case_study_background_motivation_multi_solution_result(sec.09) 保持分立 — 前者 challenge-solution 严格并列且规模紧凑(6-10 页), 后者含 background+motivation+分隔页+双视角结果差异明显; case_study_multi_observation_solution_pairs_with_end_to_end(sec.05) 与前两者节点数与递进结构不同, 单独立项。new_archetype 列表: structure_intro_computation_flow — 以计算流示意图介绍目标对象基本结构; sublayer_challenge_statement — 子层挑战断言式标题页; sublayer_innovation_answer — 子层创新方法页(多子类型); sublayer_experiment_result — 子层实验结果断言页; three_layer_summary_flow — 自上而下三框流程图收束; progressive_flow_stage_build — 逐帧 build 多阶段流程图; formula_factor_highlight — 公式因子逐层高亮; three_layer_design_summary — 多层协同设计小结; trend_lead_in_new_scenario — 引入新场景(LLM+专用模型); innovation_novel_paradigm_pair — 新范式对比示例; review_previous_tutorial_holder — 回顾旧版 tutorial 占位; progress_map_operators — 算子/性能进展路线图; industry_revolution_positioning — 工业革命时代高度升华; handoff_to_our_methods_roadmap — 双行进展+本组方法预告收束; paper_title_authors_only — 论文标题+作者+会议信息; realtime_need_vs_sota_gap — 实时需求 vs SOTA 精度缺口; computation_pipeline_overview — 目标计算流程/管线铺陈; observation_initial — Observation 首页(现象+数字); observation_extension — Observation 延伸页(证据/机制); solution_answer — Solution 断言标题+方法细节; end_to_end_performance — 端到端加速比整体证明; ablation_grid — 多象限消融; challenge_statement — 挑战断言+视觉对比; performance_headline — 断言式加速数字主结果; ablation_supplement — 消融/内存节省补充实验; framework_definition_intro — Innovation 标签+一句话定义引入自研框架; framework_performance_headline — 多组加速比数字铺陈框架性能; framework_integration_ecosystem — 三列并排展示开源生态集成; progress_roadmap_bridge — 路线图承上启下枢纽; solution_formulation — 循环维度/公式化算法空间; solution_mechanism — 具体机制(启发式模型/动态选择); performance_result — 加速比闭环; macro_ai_roadmap — 三时代阶梯+三轴维度 AI 演进路标; three_axis_trend_panel — 三列并排 panel 展开数据/模态/任务三轴; model_moore_law_growth_chart — 对数增长曲线论证模型规模摩尔定律级暴涨; supply_demand_gap_chart — 需求 vs 硬件曲线证算力供需鸿沟; solution_introduction_bridge — 性能-能效对比正式引入解法; definition_benefit_summary — 解法定义+关键倍数收束; paradigm_shift_dual_column — 左右两栏对照 1.0/2.0 范式核心差异; era_sparsity_taxonomy_table — 同构四列表格铺 1.0/2.0 稀疏性谱系, 红框强调新增行; progress_roadmap_handoff — 进展路线图收束到新方法预告; platform_benchmark_speedup — 单个硬件平台家族的加速比对比图; collaboration_institution_wall — 院校名+logo 网格展示合作学术伙伴; thanks_backpanel — 竖排 THANKS + 团队成员/赞助方 + 主题回顾 + 联系方式封底; background_tradeoff_spectrum — 谱系图/对比论证技术折衷; motivation_platform_advantage — 目标平台核心优势论证; chapter_transition_divider — 留白分隔页引出后续多解法; performance_result_platform — 目标平台自身指标结果; performance_result_cross_platform — 跨平台对比(如 GPU vs FPGA)总账收益; key_challenge_comparison_table — 训练成本对比表 challenge; innovation_mask_generation_diagram — mask 自动生成图例; innovation_dual_table_compare — 双表对比创新点;
